1.consolidated_definition: Forcejeo entre dos personas engarfando sus dedos del corazón, para ver cuál de ellas se rinde por el dolor que esto produce.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Finger wrestling between two people interlocking their fingers at the heart to see which one yields due to the pain caused by this action.
